description: This source file provides utility functions for managing workspace directories related to jobs in a software project. It determines the root workspace path based on environment variables or defaults, and constructs specific paths for job-related subdirectories, ensuring their existence.

methods.name: Path get_root_workspace()
methods.description: Returns the root path for workspaces, considering environment variable or defaulting to a 'workspace' directory. Ensures the directory exists, with fallback if needed.

methods.name: Dict[str,Path] get_job_workspace(job_id: str)
methods.description: Provides paths for various job-related directories within the workspace, creating directories if they do not exist.
